sections.heading: Description
lines: Crimson Forest is a custom field effect that does not appear in Pokémon Rejuvenation. It is based on the Nether biome of the same name and is found in the Crimson Forest biome.
The field strengthens Fire, Grass and Poison moves, punishes the Pokémon that attacks first with a move of positive priority, and rewards Pokémon that knock out an opponent (Piglin Bloodlust).

sections.heading: General Effects
lines: Fire-type, Grass-type and Poison-type moves increase in base power by 1.3x.
Special Bug-type moves increase in base power by 1.2x.
Water-type moves decrease in base power to 0.8x.
Ice-type moves decrease in base power to 0.5x.
Special Flying-type moves also count as Poison-type when type effectiveness is calculated.
Extra types change damage only; they never add same-type attack bonus.

sections.heading: Abilities Affected
lines: Effect Spore's activation rate is doubled to 60%.
Flash Fire users that are grounded power up at the end of each turn.
Good as Gold raises Speed and Special Attack by 1 stage when the bearer enters.
Grass Pelt, Leaf Guard, Overgrow and Swarm are active.
Magma Armor raises Defense by 1 stage when the bearer enters.
Merciless, Poison Heal and Toxic Boost are active as in Corrosive Mist Field.
Mimicry changes the bearer's type to Fire.
Steam Engine can raise Speed at the end of each turn.
Well-Baked Body users that are grounded raise Defense by 1 stage at the end of each turn.

sections.heading: Moves Affected
lines: Moves which receive an attack buff:
Power Whip, Vine Whip also count as Fire-type and increase in base power by 1.5x on top of the Grass-type bonus (1.95x in total).
Acid Spray, Clear Smog, Smog → 1.5x boost on top of the Poison-type bonus (1.95x in total).
Pay Day → 1.5x boost.
Make It Rain → 1.3x boost.
Other moves:
Barb Barrage and Venoshock always deal their doubled damage.
Fire Spin deals 1/6 of the target's max HP each turn.
Slash, Air Slash, Fury Cutter, Air Cutter, Psycho Cut, Breaking Swipe and Cut gain the Grass type, as in Forest Field.
Toxic and Will-O-Wisp have 100% accuracy.
Field-dependent moves:
Camouflage changes the user's type to Fire.
Nature Power becomes Power Whip.
Secret Power may inflict Burn.
Shelter halves damage from Fire-type moves.
Terrain Pulse's type becomes Fire.

sections.heading: Piglin Bloodlust
lines: When a Pokémon directly knocks out an opposing Pokémon with a move, its Attack rises by 1 stage. This stacks with Moxie.
A move that knocks out two opposing Pokémon at once raises Attack by 2 stages.
Knockouts caused by poison, burn, weather, recoil, field damage or by the user's own ally do not count.

sections.heading: Crimson Vines
lines: Damaging moves with positive priority have their final accuracy multiplied by 0.8. Moves that never miss are not affected.
If such a move misses because of this penalty, the user crashes as with High Jump Kick and loses half of its max HP. Ordinary misses, Protect and immunities never cause a crash.

sections.heading: Weather and Status
lines: Hail and Snow cannot last here and disappear as soon as they appear.
Pokémon cannot be frozen.

sections.heading: Items
lines: Elemental Seed raises Attack, Special Attack and Speed by 1 stage each and Taunts the user.
